description: Use when you need the stack or internationalization posture instead of content. view=fingerprint (default) detects the site's technology (framework, CMS, CDN) and is cached when fresh; view=i18n derives i18n maturity level and gaps from that fingerprint. Both may fetch the site once, so they are network-class tools; prefer the source repository when you can read it.

view.description: Which read to run; see the tool description for each view.

name: get_site_fingerprint
title: Read technology and i18n maturity
